subject: how does one reply to a thread in a mailing list

messages.author: Homeo Morphism
messages.body:
I'm very sorry to be asking this question, I've tried to figure it out on
my own, but I've failed...
When I post a thread to this mailing list, I simply write a letter to
amber.ambermd.org with a thread topic in a letter's subject.
But how does one reply to a message some levels deep into an already
existing thread?
Thank you.

messages.author: David Case
messages.body:
On Wed, Jan 29, 2020, Homeo Morphism wrote:
>
>But how does one reply to a message some levels deep into an already
>existing thread?
Potentially depends on your mail user agent, but using "reply" (not
"reply-to-all") should work in most cases.
....dac
